amoureux.q1: What attracted you to your partner at the start?
amoureux.q2: When you think about your partner, what do you feel?
amoureux.q2o0: My heart still races like the first day
amoureux.q2o1: A feeling of happiness and security
amoureux.q3: How do you imagine life without your partner?
amoureux.q3o0: Impossible to imagine, they're part of me
amoureux.q4: Do you have shared life plans?
amoureux.q4o3: Not really, we live in the present
amoureux.q5: How do you react to your partner's flaws?
amoureux.q5o0: I accept them, they're part of who they are
amoureux.q5o1: I learn to live with them
amoureux.q6: Does your partner still make you laugh?
amoureux.q6o0: Every day, they're my best friend
amoureux.q6o1: Often, we share the same humor
amoureux.q7: How would you describe your emotional intimacy?
amoureux.q7o0: We can say anything without judgment
amoureux.q8: Are you proud of your partner?
amoureux.q9: Does your partner make you a better person?
amoureux.q9o0: Absolutely, I'm better because of them
amoureux.q10: How do you see your couple in 10 years?
amoureux.q10o0: Still as in love, with lots of memories
amoureux.q10o2: I hope we'll still be together
amoureux.q11: Does your partner know your deepest fears?
amoureux.q11o0: Yes, and they help me overcome them
amoureux.q11o3: No, I keep that to myself
amoureux.q12: Do you feel your partner is 'the one'?
amoureux.r0d: Your love connection deserves more attention. Love is like a plant that needs watering.
amoureux.r0a: Take time to rediscover your partner. Plan romantic moments, express your feelings. Sometimes rekindling the flame requires conscious effort from both sides.
amoureux.r1d: Your love is there but could blossom more. You have good foundations to build on.
amoureux.r1a: Invest in your relationship. Create new memories together, surprise each other. Love feeds on small daily gestures.
amoureux.r2d: You share a sincere and deep love. Your connection is beautiful and authentic.
amoureux.r2a: Keep cherishing this precious bond. Don't forget to say 'I love you' and show your affection. Your love is a treasure to preserve.
amoureux.r3d: You've found your soulmate! Your connection is rare and precious.
amoureux.r3a: Congratulations! You're living a love many dream of finding. Keep supporting each other, making each other laugh, and loving like the first day.
